description: CREATES one entry from what the user said: type food/meal/snack/drink/kopi/coffee → Food Diary (with its Finance row when amount is given), expense → Finance, moment → a private Moment. Uses the same duplicate check as Dayze chat: the identical entry sent again within about 2 minutes is not saved twice and the reply says "Already logged that a moment ago". Shows in Dayze with "Added by <this app>" and can be undone from the record. Returns the saved record id (food_id, expense_id or moment_id). ($0.10; API key required)

amount.description: Price paid, a positive number. Required for type expense.

category.description: Optional Finance category, type expense only.

request_id.description: A new id (UUID) per write; send the same value again only to retry this exact call (the retry returns the first result).

text.description: What the user had, bought or did, in their words (max 500). For food the item ("kopi peng"); for an expense what it was for.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone of the user's device (e.g. Asia/Singapore). Used only when the account has no zone set; the profile zone wins.

when.description: Optional ISO 8601 instant with offset when it happened. Leave out for now.
